thesis_statement: Kratos is a pure-play affordable-defense disruptor: 30.5% revenue growth (19.1% organic), a 1.3x trailing book-to-bill, and a growing backlog in drones, hypersonics and space, deliberately running near GAAP breakeven while funding its own R&D for programs like Valkyrie that incumbents cannot price against.

base.summary: High-teens organic growth converts to positive operating income as production ramps scale, and book-to-bill stays above 1.
drivers: Defense Rocket Systems +50.2%, Turbine Technologies +43.3%, Microwave Products +29.5% organic growth
raised FY26 revenue guidance to $1.750-1.810B (18-23% organic growth)
Valkyrie production ramp and company-owned sales returning cash

bull.summary: Affordable-mass defense budgets (drones, counter-drone, hypersonics) keep expanding and Kratos wins program-of-record status, driving operating margin into the mid-single digits and the multiple re-rates on proven profitability.
drivers: increased internal R&D in Space, Satellite, Unmanned Systems, Microwave
joint-venture production partnerships scaling without balance-sheet strain

bear.summary: Growth stays unprofitable: GAAP operating loss persists, free cash flow stays negative through working-capital build, and a ~268x trailing multiple collapses on any growth disappointment.
drivers: Q2 operating loss of $1.6M; FCF used $18.9M

key_risks: Profitability is the entire story: the company ran a GAAP operating loss (-$1.6M) and used $18.9M of free cash in the quarter; net income was positive only on non-operating items.
Valuation leaves zero margin for error: ~268x trailing and ~41x forward earnings.
Government demand concentration: bookings hinge on defense-budget priorities that shift with politics.
The band is wide (44.81-51.60, ~15%) with reference confidence only 40, and the SQL status label is a stale 08-21 BELOW_STOP snapshot that disagrees with the current in-band position.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (41.48 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: Organic revenue growth falls below 10% for two consecutive quarters.
GAAP operating loss widens for two consecutive quarters despite revenue growth.

catalysts.event: Valkyrie/drone program-of-record awards and hypersonic milestones

evidence.claim: Q2 2026: revenues $458.8M, +30.5% (organic +19.1%); KGS organic +22.0% (Defense Rocket Systems +50.2%, Turbine Technologies +43.3%, Microwave Products +29.5%); KUS +8.1%; GAAP operating loss $1.6M; GAAP net income $4.4M ($0.02/sh) vs $2.9M; adjusted EPS $0.21 vs $0.11; adjusted EBITDA $38.2M; book-to-bill 1.1x quarter, 1.3x LTM ($1.99B bookings); FCF used $18.9M (working capital from 30.5% growth, inventory ramp); FY26 revenue guidance raised to $1.750-1.810B, organic +18-23%; Q2 included $16.3M stock comp, $13.6M company-funded R&D, $12.5M amortization
evidence.source: Kratos Q2 2026 financial results, SEC 8-K exhibit 99.1 (sec.gov .../ktos202606288kexhibit991.htm, 2026-08-04)
